```{=html}
<style>
/* ── Notation: chords, rhythm, pitches and words entered in any order, in chunks and voices, written as ABC ─── */
#nt-root{--nt-ink:var(--site-ink,#1e1c18);--nt-ink2:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246);--nt-line:var(--site-border,#e0d8ce);--nt-surface:var(--site-surface,#fff);
  --nt-surface2:var(--site-surface-2,#f2ede5);--nt-acc:var(--site-accent,#3fc2b4);--nt-accdk:var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90);--nt-acctext:var(--site-accent-text,#0a4f47);
  --nt-accbg:var(--site-accent-bg,rgba(63,194,180,.12));
  padding:1.25rem clamp(16px,3vw,40px) 4rem;color:var(--nt-ink);font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;line-height:1.5}
#nt-root *{box-sizing:border-box}
#nt-root [hidden]{display:none!important}
#nt-root .nt-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(320px,400px) 9.5rem;gap:24px;align-items:start}
/* the sidebar: a column of its own, beside the two columns of parts (as on Timestamp Notes), staying put as the page scrolls */
#nt-root .nt-nav{position:sticky;top:72px;font-size:.85rem;max-height:calc(100vh - 88px);overflow-y:auto}
#nt-root .nt-nav p{font:600 .68rem/1 var(--font-mono,'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--nt-ink2);margin:0 0 .5rem}
#nt-root .nt-nav ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;border-left:2px solid var(--nt-line)}
#nt-root .nt-nav a{display:block;padding:.25rem .6rem;margin-left:-2px;border-left:2px solid transparent;color:var(--nt-ink2);text-decoration:none;line-height:1.25}
#nt-root .nt-nav a:hover{color:var(--nt-ink)}
#nt-root .nt-nav a.is-here{border-left-color:var(--nt-accdk);color:var(--nt-acctext);font-weight:600}
#nt-root .nt-nav a.is-shut{opacity:.6}
#nt-root .nt-nav .nt-nav-tip{margin:.7rem 0 .5rem;font:400 .72rem/1.35 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
#nt-root .nt-nav .nt-reset-cols{width:100%;font-size:.75rem}
#nt-root .nt-main.pc-empty,#nt-root .nt-side.pc-empty{min-height:12rem}
#nt-root .nt-layout>*{grid-column:auto!important}   /* Quarto puts page-columns on it */
#nt-root .nt-main,#nt-root .nt-side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;min-width:0}
#nt-root .nt-side details.nt-panel{background:var(--nt-surface2)}
#nt-root .nt-side .nt-start{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}

/* Play it in: the record button, bar counter, beat lights, what is being played, a strip of keys */
#nt-root .nt-deck{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:1.2rem;align-items:center}
#nt-root .nt-go{width:8rem;height:8rem;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:#b3261e;color:#fff;font:700 1.05rem/1.2 inherit;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
#nt-root .nt-go small{display:block;font-weight:400;font-size:.75rem;opacity:.85;margin-top:.2rem}
#nt-root .nt-go.is-on{background:#1e1c18;animation:nt-pulse 1s infinite}
@keyframes nt-pulse{50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(179,38,30,.25)}}
#nt-root .nt-qstate{font:700 2rem/1.1 var(--font-mono,monospace)}
#nt-root .nt-qstate.is-count{color:#b3261e}
#nt-root .nt-qbeats{display:flex;gap:.4rem;margin:.5rem 0}
#nt-root .nt-qbeats span{width:1.1rem;height:1.1rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--nt-surface2);border:1px solid var(--nt-line)}
#nt-root .nt-qbeats span.is-on{background:var(--nt-accdk);border-color:var(--nt-accdk)}
#nt-root .nt-qbeats span.is-on.is-one{background:#b3261e;border-color:#b3261e}
#nt-root .nt-heard{font:600 1.1rem/1.4 var(--font-mono,monospace);min-height:1.6em;color:var(--nt-ink2);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#nt-root .nt-keys{margin-top:.8rem;height:44px;position:relative;border:1px solid var(--nt-line);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
#nt-root .nt-keys i{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;border-right:1px solid #ddd}
#nt-root .nt-keys i.k-b{background:#333;bottom:40%;z-index:1;border:0}
#nt-root .nt-keys i.is-down{background:var(--nt-acc)!important}
#nt-root .nt-quick{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem .9rem;margin-top:1rem;padding-top:.8rem;border-top:1px solid var(--nt-line)}
#nt-root .nt-quick select,#nt-root .nt-quick input{height:1.9rem;font-size:.85rem}
@media (max-width:640px){ #nt-root .nt-deck{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)} }
#nt-root .nt-wide{grid-column:1 / -1}
#nt-root .nt-intro{border-left:3px solid var(--nt-acc);padding-left:1rem;margin:0 0 1rem;color:var(--nt-ink2);font-size:.95rem;max-width:80ch}

/* sections: collapsible */
#nt-root details.nt-panel{background:var(--nt-surface);border:1px solid var(--nt-line);border-radius:10px;scroll-margin-top:80px}
#nt-root details.nt-panel.is-lit{outline:3px solid var(--nt-acc);outline-offset:2px}
#nt-root details.nt-panel>summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;padding:.75rem 1.1rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;user-select:none}
#nt-root details.nt-panel>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
#nt-root details.nt-panel>summary::before{content:"\25B8";font-size:.8rem;color:var(--nt-ink2);transition:transform .15s}
#nt-root details.nt-panel[open]>summary::before{transform:rotate(90deg)}
#nt-root details.nt-panel>summary h2{margin:0;font-size:.98rem;font-weight:600;border:0;padding:0}
#nt-root details.nt-panel>summary .nt-sum{margin-left:auto;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--nt-ink2);font-weight:400}
#nt-root .nt-body{padding:0 1.1rem 1rem}

/* jump bar */

/* controls */
#nt-root .nt-row{display:flex;gap:.5rem .8rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:.6rem}
#nt-root .nt-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.25rem}
#nt-root .nt-field label,#nt-root .nt-lab{font:600 .68rem/1 var(--font-mono,'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--nt-ink2)}
#nt-root select,#nt-root input[type=text],#nt-root input[type=number]{height:2.1rem;padding:0 .55rem;border:1px solid var(--nt-line);border-radius:7px;background:var(--nt-surface);color:inherit;font:inherit;font-size:.9rem}
#nt-root input[type=number]{width:4.2rem}
#nt-root .nt-btn{min-height:2.1rem;padding:.25rem .8rem;border:1px solid var(--nt-accdk);border-radius:7px;background:var(--nt-surface);color:var(--nt-acctext);font:inherit;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
#nt-root .nt-btn:hover{background:var(--nt-accbg)}
#nt-root .nt-btn.is-main,#nt-root .nt-btn[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--nt-accdk);color:#fff}
#nt-root .nt-through{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.3rem;font-size:.88rem;cursor:pointer}
#nt-root .nt-btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default;background:var(--nt-surface)}
#nt-root .nt-start{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:.6rem}
#nt-root .nt-start button{text-align:left;padding:.7rem .9rem;line-height:1.35}
#nt-root .nt-start button small{display:block;font-weight:400;color:var(--nt-ink2);margin-top:.2rem}
#nt-root .nt-hint{margin:.5rem 0 0;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--nt-ink2);max-width:75ch}
#nt-root .nt-warn{margin:.5rem 0 0;font-size:.88rem;color:#8a4b00}
#nt-root kbd{font:600 .75rem var(--font-mono,monospace);border:1px solid var(--nt-line);border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:4px;padding:0 .3rem;background:var(--nt-surface2)}
#nt-root .nt-tonality{display:flex;align-items:center;height:2.1rem;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
#nt-root .nt-keyguess{margin-top:.7rem;padding:.6rem .8rem;border-radius:8px;background:var(--nt-accbg);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;align-items:center}

/* chunk sheet */
#nt-root .nt-sheet-wrap{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--nt-line);border-radius:8px}
#nt-root table.nt-sheet{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.88rem}
#nt-root .nt-sheet th{font:600 .66rem/1.2 var(--font-mono,monospace);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--nt-ink2);text-align:left;padding:.5rem .55rem;background:var(--nt-surface2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--nt-line);white-space:nowrap}
#nt-root .nt-sheet td{padding:.25rem .55rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--nt-line);white-space:nowrap}
#nt-root .nt-sheet tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
#nt-root .nt-sheet tbody tr{cursor:pointer}
#nt-root .nt-sheet tbody tr:hover{background:var(--nt-accbg)}
#nt-root .nt-sheet tbody tr[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--nt-accbg);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--nt-accdk)}
#nt-root .nt-sheet td.nt-num{color:var(--nt-ink2);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;width:2rem}
#nt-root .nt-sheet td.nt-c{text-align:center}
#nt-root .nt-sheet th.nt-c{text-align:center}
#nt-root .nt-sheet input.nt-name{height:1.9rem;width:100%;min-width:8rem;border-color:transparent;background:transparent}
#nt-root .nt-sheet input.nt-name:hover,#nt-root .nt-sheet input.nt-name:focus{border-color:var(--nt-line);background:var(--nt-surface)}
#nt-root .nt-yes{color:var(--nt-accdk);font-weight:700}
#nt-root .nt-no{color:var(--nt-line)}
#nt-root .nt-later{color:var(--nt-ink2);opacity:.5}
#nt-root .nt-change{font:600 .78rem var(--font-mono,monospace);color:#8a4b00}
#nt-root .nt-tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;align-items:center;margin-top:.7rem}
#nt-root .nt-tools .nt-sep{width:1px;align-self:stretch;background:var(--nt-line);margin:0 .2rem}

/* rhythm bank: as in the Song Builder */
#nt-root .cell-criteria{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 14px;font-size:.9rem}
#nt-root .cell-criteria label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-weight:normal}
#nt-root .cell-criteria input[type=checkbox]{width:auto;margin:0}
#nt-root .cell-bank{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end;gap:6px;margin:.6rem 0 .5rem}
#nt-root .cell-fixed{display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:4px;flex-basis:100%}
#nt-root .cell-wrapper{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
#nt-root .cell-number{font-size:11px;color:var(--nt-ink2);margin-bottom:2px;margin-left:4px}
#nt-root .cell-btn{background:#fff!important;border:1px solid #ced4da!important;border-radius:.375rem!important;cursor:pointer!important;padding:2px!important;
  box-sizing:content-box!important;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .12s,box-shadow .12s}
#nt-root .cell-btn:hover{border-color:#2780e3!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(39,128,227,.15)!important}
#nt-root .cell-preview{pointer-events:none}
#nt-root .cell-preview svg{display:block}
#nt-root #nt-cells .abcjs-staff{display:none}
#nt-root #nt-pending .abcjs-stem,#nt-root .nt-pitchonly .abcjs-stem{display:none}
#nt-root .nt-crow{margin:0 0 .35rem}
#nt-root .nt-loop-rows{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:.4rem 0;max-height:22rem;overflow:auto}
#nt-root .nt-loop-rows li{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;align-items:center;padding:.15rem .3rem;border-radius:4px}
#nt-root .nt-loop-rows li.is-cur{background:rgba(127,127,127,.12)}
#nt-root .nt-loop-rows li.is-on{outline:2px solid #3fc2b4}
#nt-root .nt-loop-rows .nt-lname{min-width:4.5em;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
#nt-root .nt-loop-rows .nt-lbars{opacity:.7;font-size:.85em;min-width:6em}
#nt-root .nt-loop-rows .nt-lset button{padding:0 .4em}
#nt-root .nt-lstat{font-size:.75em;padding:0 .4em;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid currentColor}
#nt-root .nt-lstat.is-empty{opacity:.5}#nt-root .nt-lstat.is-draft{border-style:dashed}
#nt-root .nt-draft{margin-left:.5em;padding:0 .4em;border:1px dashed currentColor;border-radius:3px;font-size:.75em;opacity:.75}
#nt-root .nt-cline{display:flex;align-items:center}
#nt-root .nt-nl{border:0;background:none;color:#b3261e;font-size:1.2rem;line-height:1;padding:0 .3rem;cursor:pointer}
#nt-root .nt-nl:hover{color:#000}
#nt-root .nt-keypick,#nt-root .nt-meterpick{display:inline-flex;gap:.3rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
#nt-root .nt-meterpick input{width:3.4rem}
#nt-root .nt-enh{padding:.25rem .5rem;min-width:0}
#nt-root .nt-ctitle{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:1.4rem;text-align:center;margin:.3rem 0 .2rem}
#nt-root .nt-clab{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--nt-ink2);cursor:pointer;margin:.2rem 0 -.2rem .3rem}
#nt-root .nt-crow.is-cur .nt-clab{color:#b3261e;font-weight:600}
#nt-root .nt-csec{font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;margin:.6rem 0 0 .3rem}
#nt-root .nt-cempty{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--nt-ink2);margin:.1rem 0 .4rem .3rem;font-style:italic}
#nt-root #nt-insert[aria-pressed=true]{background:#b3261e;border-color:#b3261e;color:#fff}
#nt-root .nt-caret{stroke:#b3261e;stroke-width:2.5}

/* staff and code */
#nt-root .nt-scope{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;margin-left:auto;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--nt-ink2)}
#nt-root .nt-scope[hidden]{display:none}
#nt-root .nt-scope select{height:1.9rem;font-size:.85rem;max-width:14rem}
#nt-root .nt-paper{margin-top:.6rem;overflow-x:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:6px}
#nt-root .nt-paper .nt-chord-on,#nt-root .nt-paper .nt-chord-on *{fill:#b3261e!important}
#nt-chord-ed{position:absolute;z-index:2000;font:600 15px var(--font-mono,monospace);width:6.5em;padding:1px 4px;border:2px solid #b3261e;border-radius:4px;background:#fff3f1;color:#b3261e}
#nt-root .nt-cbars{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;margin:.3rem 0 .2rem;font:600 .85rem var(--font-mono,monospace)}
#nt-root .nt-cbar{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;align-items:center;padding:1px 6px;border-left:2px solid var(--nt-line)}
#nt-root .nt-cchip{border:0;background:none;padding:1px 4px;border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer;color:inherit;font:inherit}
#nt-root .nt-cchip.is-on{background:#b3261e;color:#fff}
#nt-root .nt-paper .nt-sel,#nt-root .nt-paper .nt-sel *{fill:#b3261e!important;stroke:#b3261e}
#nt-root .nt-paper .nt-playing,#nt-root .nt-paper .nt-playing *{fill:#1565c0!important;stroke:#1565c0}
#nt-root .nt-paper .nt-playing{scroll-margin-top:90px}
#nt-root .nt-paper .abcjs-note,#nt-root .nt-paper .abcjs-rest{cursor:pointer}
#nt-root textarea{display:block;width:100%;min-height:12rem;margin-top:.6rem;padding:.7rem .8rem;resize:vertical;border:1px solid var(--nt-line);border-radius:7px;
  background:var(--nt-surface2);color:inherit;font-family:var(--font-mono,'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace);font-size:.84rem;line-height:1.55}
#nt-root .nt-status{margin:.5rem 0 0;min-height:1.3em;font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--nt-ink2)}

@media (max-width:1100px){
  #nt-root .nt-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  #nt-root .nt-side{display:contents}
  #nt-root .nt-nav{order:-1;top:56px;z-index:5;max-height:none;overflow:visible;background:var(--site-bg,#faf7f2);padding:.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--nt-line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem}
  #nt-root .nt-nav p,#nt-root .nt-nav .nt-reset-cols{display:none}
  #nt-root .nt-nav ul{flex:1;min-width:0}
  #nt-root .nt-nav ul{display:flex;overflow-x:auto;border-left:0;gap:.2rem}
  #nt-root .nt-nav a{white-space:nowrap;border-left:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin:0}
  #nt-root .nt-nav a.is-here{border-bottom-color:var(--nt-accdk)}
}
#nt-root .nt-btn.is-rec{background:#b3261e;border-color:#b3261e;color:#fff}
#nt-root .nt-voice{display:flex;gap:.5rem;align-items:center;margin-top:.4rem}
#nt-root .nt-voice input[type=text]{width:7rem}
#nt-root .nt-target{display:flex;gap:.35rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
#nt-root .nt-big{font:600 1.05rem/1.4 var(--font-mono,monospace);min-height:1.5em;margin-top:.6rem}
#nt-root input.nt-wide-in{width:100%}
#nt-root textarea.nt-short{min-height:5rem}
#nt-root .nt-sheet tr.nt-sec td{background:var(--nt-surface2);border-top:2px solid var(--nt-line);padding:.3rem .55rem}
#nt-root .nt-sheet tr.nt-sec[aria-selected=true] td{box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--nt-accdk)}
#nt-root .nt-sec-in{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem}
#nt-root .nt-sec-in input{font-weight:700;height:1.9rem;border-color:transparent;background:transparent;min-width:8rem}
#nt-root .nt-sec-in input:hover,#nt-root .nt-sec-in input:focus{border-color:var(--nt-line);background:var(--nt-surface)}
#nt-root .nt-eye{border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--nt-ink2);width:1.6rem;padding:0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
#nt-root .nt-eye[aria-pressed=false]{opacity:.45}
#nt-root tr.nt-sec.nt-off input{opacity:.55;text-decoration:line-through}
#nt-root tr.nt-off:not(.nt-sec) td:not(.nt-num){opacity:.5}
#nt-root td.nt-num .nt-eye{margin-right:.15rem;vertical-align:middle}
#nt-root .nt-sheet-all{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;margin:0 0 .5rem}
#nt-root .nt-fold{border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--nt-ink2);width:1.4rem;padding:0}
#nt-root .nt-sec-in .nt-mini{min-height:1.7rem;padding:0 .45rem;font-size:.78rem}
#nt-root .nt-sec-in .nt-sec-sum{margin-left:auto;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--nt-ink2);font-weight:400}
#nt-root .nt-sheet tr.nt-in td:nth-child(2){padding-left:1.4rem}
#nt-root .nt-style{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.3rem;min-height:1.7rem;padding:0 .5rem;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;max-width:9rem;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
#nt-root .nt-style.is-inherited{color:var(--nt-ink2);border-color:var(--nt-line);font-weight:400}
#nt-root .nt-band-ico{width:1.05rem;height:1.05rem;flex:0 0 auto}
#nt-root .nt-style span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#nt-root .nt-style.is-none{color:var(--nt-ink2);border-style:dashed;border-color:var(--nt-line);font-weight:400}
#nt-root #nt-dwim-host .md-list{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(19rem,100%),1fr))}
#nt-root #nt-dwim-host .md-card{min-width:0}
#nt-root #nt-dwim-host .md-prev{max-width:100%;min-width:0}
/* ?ending=1: embedded in the Write an Ending lesson (lessons/write-an-ending.qmd), a pared-down page */
#nt-root.nt-ending .nt-intro,#nt-root.nt-ending #nt-start-panel,#nt-root.nt-ending #nt-take,#nt-root.nt-ending #nt-dwim,
#nt-root.nt-ending #nt-cho,#nt-root.nt-ending #nt-words,#nt-root.nt-ending #nt-band-piece,#nt-root.nt-ending #nt-band-note,
#nt-root.nt-ending #nt-setup,#nt-root.nt-ending #nt-chunks-panel,#nt-root.nt-ending #nt-chords,#nt-root.nt-ending #nt-score,
#nt-root.nt-ending #nt-abc,#nt-root.nt-ending #nt-quick,#nt-root.nt-ending .nt-voice-pick{display:none!important}   /* only Rhythm and Notes: the lesson draws the score */
#nt-root.nt-ending .nt-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important}
#nt-root.nt-ending .nt-side{display:contents}
#nt-root.nt-ending{padding-top:.5rem}
#nt-root .nt-seltools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;align-items:center;margin-top:.6rem}
  .nt-vimline { font: 0.8rem ui-monospace, monospace; min-height: 1.2em; opacity: 0.75; }
  textarea.vim-normal { caret-color: transparent; }
</style>

<div id="nt-root">
  <div class="nt-panel nt-dict" id="nt-dict" hidden style="padding:.8rem 1.1rem;margin-bottom:1rem">
    <strong>Dictation</strong> <span id="nt-dict-what">Waiting for the Dictation page...</span>
    <div class="nt-row">
      <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-dict-hear">&#9654; Hear it again</button>
      <button type="button" class="nt-btn is-main" id="nt-dict-hand">Hand in</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="nt-intro">The quickest way in: press <kbd>r</kbd> and play the tune on a MIDI keyboard, a phrase at a time. Each take becomes a chunk. Chords, rhythms, typed notes and words go in from the sidebar, in any order. Click a note on the staff and move it with the arrow keys.</p>

  <div class="nt-layout">
    <div class="nt-main">
      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-quick" open>
        <summary><h2>Play it in</h2><span class="nt-sum" id="nt-q-midi">MIDI: not connected</span></summary>
        <div class="nt-body">
          <div class="nt-deck">
            <button type="button" class="nt-go" id="nt-q-go">&#9679; Record<small>r / pedal</small></button>
            <div>
              <div class="nt-qstate" id="nt-q-state">Ready</div>
              <div class="nt-qbeats" id="nt-q-beats"></div>
              <div class="nt-heard" id="nt-q-heard"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="nt-keys" id="nt-q-keys" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <div class="nt-quick">
            <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-q-meter">Meter</label><select id="nt-q-meter"></select></div>
            <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-q-key">Key</label><select id="nt-q-key" data-kind="key"></select></div>
            <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-q-bpm">Tempo</label><input type="number" id="nt-q-bpm" min="30" max="240" value="90"></div>
            <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-q-count">Count-in</label><select id="nt-q-count"><option value="1">1 bar</option><option value="2">2 bars</option></select></div>
            <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-q-pickup">Pickup</label><select id="nt-q-pickup"></select></div>
            <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-q-res">Shortest note</label><select id="nt-q-res"><option value="1">Eighth</option><option value="0.5">Sixteenth</option></select></div>
            <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-q-feel">Feel</label><select id="nt-q-feel"><option value="straight">Straight</option><option value="swing">Swing</option></select></div>
            <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-q-trip">Triplets</label><select id="nt-q-trip"><option value="off">Off</option><option value="auto">Find them</option></select></div>
            <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-q-split" title="Notes below this key are the left hand; this key and above the right hand (the melody).">Split at</label><select id="nt-q-split"><option value="60">C4 (middle C)</option><option value="55">G3</option><option value="53">F3</option><option value="48">C3</option><option value="0">No split</option></select></div>
            <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-q-lh" title="Chord symbols: the left hand's chords named over the bars. Notated: the left hand written out on a bass staff (a voice of its own), with or without chord symbols.">Left hand</label><select id="nt-q-lh"><option value="chords">Chord symbols</option><option value="notate">Notated (bass staff)</option><option value="both">Notated + chord symbols</option></select></div>
            <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-q-quiet">Ends after</label><select id="nt-q-quiet"><option value="2">2 quiet bars</option><option value="1">1 quiet bar</option><option value="4">4 quiet bars</option><option value="0">Only when stopped</option></select></div>
          </div>
          <div class="nt-row">
            <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-q-redo" disabled>Redo the last take</button>
            <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-q-drop" disabled>Drop the last take</button>
          </div>
          <p class="nt-hint">Each take is a chunk of its own, after the selected one, in the selected voice. The right hand plays the melody; when the left hand plays chords (two notes or more together below the <strong>Left hand</strong> key) they are named and written over the bars; a take with no left-hand chords is all melody. Notes played in the last bar of the count-in of the piece's first take make a <strong>pickup</strong>, up to almost a whole bar. <kbd>r</kbd> or the sustain pedal records, <kbd>Space</kbd>, the pedal or <kbd>Esc</kbd> stops, <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>R</kbd> redoes the last take, <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Backspace</kbd> drops it.</p>
          <p class="nt-hint" id="nt-q-status" aria-live="polite"></p>
        </div>
      </details>

      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-score" open>
          <summary><h2>The music</h2></summary>
          <div class="nt-body">
            <div class="nt-row" style="margin-top:0">
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn is-main" id="nt-play">&#9654; Play</button>
              <label class="nt-through" title="Space plays on through the chunks after this one, to the end of the piece, instead of stopping at the chunk's end"><input type="checkbox" id="nt-through"> Play through</label>
              <label class="nt-through" title="While playing: when the sounding note goes below the bottom of the window, the page jumps so it is at the top"><input type="checkbox" id="nt-follow"> Follow</label>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-undo">Undo</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-new">Start over</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-insert" aria-pressed="false" title="i: new rhythm goes in at the caret (h / l move it) instead of at the end">Insert mode</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-file-save" title="Download the whole piece as a file, to open again later">Save to file</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-file-open" title="Open a piece saved with Save to file (or an .abc file)">Open file</button>
              <input type="file" id="nt-file-in" accept=".json,.abc,.txt,application/json" hidden>
              <label class="nt-scope" title="Bars on each line of the score (a pickup bar not counted). Empty: as many as fit. RET puts a line break of your own after the active note's bar (↴); RET there again, or a click on ↴, takes it away.">Line break every <input type="number" id="nt-lines" min="1" max="32" placeholder="fit" style="width:3.6rem"> bars</label>
              <label class="nt-scope" id="nt-scope-l" hidden>Show <select id="nt-scope" title="The whole piece, or one section of it (as the Backing Track's tune notation does)"></select></label>
            </div>
            <div class="nt-seltools" id="nt-seltools">
              <span class="nt-lab" id="nt-sel-what">Nothing selected</span>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-s-split" title="The chunk is split so that a new one starts on this note">Split here</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-s-copy">Copy</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-s-cut">Cut</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-s-paste">Paste after</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-s-del">Delete</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn is-main" id="nt-s-dwim" title="Do what I mean: the other ways the selected bars could be written from how they were played">DWIM</button>
            </div>
            <div class="nt-paper" id="nt-paper"></div>
            <div id="nt-pending-wrap" hidden>
              <p class="nt-lab" style="margin-top:.8rem">Pitches only (waiting for a rhythm)</p>
              <div class="nt-paper" id="nt-pending"></div>
            </div>
            <p class="nt-hint"><kbd>Shift</kbd>+click a second note to select everything between (one voice), then copy (<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>/<kbd>⌘</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd>), cut (<kbd>X</kbd>), paste after it (<kbd>V</kbd>) or <kbd>Delete</kbd>. Click a note, then <kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd> move it to the next note in the key, <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd> by a half step, <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd> by an octave. <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> pick the note before or after, <kbd>Esc</kbd> lets go. Slashes are rhythm with no note yet.</p>
            <p class="nt-status" id="nt-status" aria-live="polite"></p>
            <p class="nt-phrase" id="nt-phrase" hidden><span id="nt-phrase-label"></span> <button type="button" class="nt-btn is-main" id="nt-back" title="Back to Timestamp Notes, looping the next phrase">Back to the recording, next phrase</button> <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-back-again" title="Back to Timestamp Notes, this phrase again">This phrase again</button> <span id="nt-passes" class="nt-passes" hidden title="Each pass of the loop you played is a take: pick the one to keep"></span> <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-seam-keep" hidden title="Where the pickup and the end of the phrase before both sounded, keep the phrase before's notes">Keep the earlier notes</button></p>
          </div>
        </details>

      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-chunks-panel" open>
          <summary><h2>Chunks</h2><span class="nt-sum" id="nt-chunks-sum"></span></summary>
          <div class="nt-body">
            <p class="nt-hint" style="margin-top:0"><kbd>j</kbd> / <kbd>k</kbd> select the next / previous chunk; <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>j</kbd> / <kbd>k</kbd> move it down / up; <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>j</kbd> / <kbd>k</kbd> move its section. Top to bottom is start to end. What you enter goes into the selected row. Sections (Verse, Chorus ...) gather the chunks under them, fold like headings, and move or duplicate as a block. <strong>Style</strong> opens the Backing Track on its Band tab for that row: what you set there is kept here, for the chunk, the section, or (with the button in The piece) the whole piece. The most particular wins: a chunk's own settings, else its section's, else the piece's.</p>
            <div class="nt-sheet-all" id="nt-sheet-all" role="toolbar" aria-label="All sections">
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn nt-mini" id="nt-fold-all">Fold all</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn nt-mini" id="nt-eye-all">Hide all</button>
            </div>
            <div class="nt-sheet-wrap"><table class="nt-sheet" id="nt-sheet"><thead></thead><tbody></tbody></table></div>
            <div class="nt-tools" role="toolbar" aria-label="Selected chunk">
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-c-up" title="Move up">&#8593; Up</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-c-down" title="Move down">&#8595; Down</button>
              <span class="nt-sep"></span>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-c-add">+ New after</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-c-dup">Duplicate</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-c-join" title="J: the next chunk goes on the end of this one">Join with next</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-c-merge" title="Rhythm only + pitches only become one chunk; two the same length become two voices">Merge with next</button>
              <span class="nt-sep"></span>
              <label class="nt-lab" for="nt-c-at" id="nt-c-at-lab">Split after bar</label>
              <input type="number" id="nt-c-at" min="1" value="1">
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-c-split">Split</button>
              <span class="nt-sep"></span>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-c-del">Delete</button>
              <span class="nt-sep"></span>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-c-sec">Start a section here</button>
            </div>
            <div class="nt-row">
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-c-meter">Meter from here</label><select id="nt-c-meter"></select></div>
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-c-key">Key from here</label><select id="nt-c-key" data-kind="key"></select></div>
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-c-tempo">Tempo from here</label><input type="number" id="nt-c-tempo" min="20" max="320" style="width:5.5rem"></div>
            </div>
            <p class="nt-warn" id="nt-c-msg" hidden></p>
          </div>
        </details>

      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-setup" open>
          <summary><h2>The piece</h2><span class="nt-sum" id="nt-setup-sum"></span></summary>
          <div class="nt-body">
            <div class="nt-row" style="margin-top:0">
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-title">Title</label><input type="text" id="nt-title" placeholder="Untitled"></div>
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-meter">Meter</label><select id="nt-meter"></select></div>
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-key">Key</label><select id="nt-key" data-kind="key"></select></div>
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-tempo">Tempo</label><input type="number" id="nt-tempo" min="20" max="320" placeholder="90" style="width:5.5rem"></div>
              <div class="nt-field"><span class="nt-lab" id="nt-tonality-lab">Heard as</span><output id="nt-tonality" class="nt-tonality" aria-labelledby="nt-tonality-lab" title="From the key and the chords: dominant sevenths on I and IV make a blues."></output></div>
            </div>
            <div class="nt-keyguess" id="nt-keyguess" hidden>
              <span id="nt-keyguess-text"></span>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn is-main" id="nt-keyguess-yes">Yes, use it</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-keyguess-no">No, I'll choose</button>
            </div>
            <p class="nt-hint" id="nt-key-hint"></p>
            <div class="nt-row">
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-band-piece">Band for the whole piece</button>
              <span class="nt-hint" id="nt-band-note" style="margin:0"></span>
            </div>
            <p class="nt-lab" style="margin-top:1rem">Voices</p>
            <div id="nt-voices"></div>
            <div class="nt-row">
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-voice-add">+ Add a voice</button>
              <div class="nt-target" role="group" aria-label="How the voices are written" id="nt-staffs">
                <button type="button" class="nt-btn" data-together="1">On one staff</button>
                <button type="button" class="nt-btn" data-together="0">A staff each</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </details>

      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-dwim" open>
          <summary><h2>DWIM</h2><span class="nt-sum" id="nt-dwim-sum"></span></summary>
          <div class="nt-body">
            <p class="nt-hint" style="margin-top:0">Do what I mean: select bars that were played in (<strong>Play it in time</strong>) and press <strong>DWIM</strong> to see the other ways they could be written, best first. The playing is kept with the chunk, so this keeps working after edits elsewhere, after splitting on a bar line, merging, duplicating, and after a reload.</p>
            <p class="nt-warn" id="nt-dwim-warn" hidden></p>
            <div id="nt-dwim-host"></div>
          </div>
        </details>

      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-abc" open>
          <summary><h2>ABC</h2></summary>
          <div class="nt-body">
            <p class="nt-hint" style="margin-top:0">Edit the code and the staff follows. Chunks start at <code>"^Name"</code> labels and at <code>[M:]</code> / <code>[K:]</code> changes; voices are <code>[V:1]</code> lines.</p>
            <label class="nt-hint" style="display:inline-flex;gap:.4em;align-items:center;margin:0 0 .3em"><input type="checkbox" id="nt-abc-vim" checked> Vim keys (Esc: normal mode, <kbd>i</kbd> to type; <kbd>=</kbd> respells the note under the cursor; <kbd>Tab</kbd> back to the score)</label>
            <textarea id="nt-abc-text" spellcheck="false" aria-label="ABC code"></textarea>
            <div id="nt-abc-vimline" class="nt-vimline" aria-live="polite"></div>
            <p class="nt-warn" id="nt-abc-warn" hidden></p>
          </div>
        </details>

      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-cho" open>
          <summary><h2>ChordPro</h2></summary>
          <div class="nt-body">
            <p class="nt-hint" style="margin-top:0">The chords and words of the piece, and at the end the notes as an ABC block (<code>{start_of_abc}</code> … <code>{end_of_abc}</code>), so this text is the whole song. Edit the words or the ABC here and the piece follows. ChordPro without an ABC block has no rhythm or notes: reading it in replaces the piece with its chords (one a bar, or as the <kbd>|</kbd> marks say) and words.</p>
            <textarea id="nt-cho-text" spellcheck="false" aria-label="ChordPro"></textarea>
            <div class="nt-row">
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-cho-read">Read this ChordPro in</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-cho-copy">Copy</button>
            </div>
            <p class="nt-warn" id="nt-cho-warn" hidden></p>
          </div>
        </details>
    </div>

    <aside class="nt-side" aria-label="Other ways to enter music">
      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-start-panel" open>
        <summary><h2>Other ways in</h2></summary>
        <div class="nt-body">
          <div class="nt-start">
            <button type="button" class="nt-btn" data-go="nt-pitch">Some notes<small>Type letters, play the computer keys like a piano, or use a MIDI keyboard. Add the rhythm later.</small></button>
            <button type="button" class="nt-btn" data-go="nt-rhythm">A rhythm<small>Pick a meter, then build the rhythm from patterns. Add the notes later.</small></button>
            <button type="button" class="nt-btn" data-go="nt-chords">Chords<small>Type them bar by bar, or play them on a keyboard. No key needed.</small></button>
            <button type="button" class="nt-btn" data-go="nt-take">Play it in time: more<small>Chords as well as notes, a fixed length, into the selected chunk.</small></button>
            <button type="button" class="nt-btn" data-go="nt-abc">ABC or ChordPro I already have<small>Paste it in, then change what you like.</small></button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </details>

      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-pitch" open>
          <summary><h2>Notes</h2><span class="nt-sum" id="nt-pitch-sum"></span></summary>
          <div class="nt-body">
            <div class="nt-target nt-voice-pick" role="group" aria-label="Voice"></div>
            <div class="nt-row" role="group" aria-label="How to enter notes">
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" data-mode="letters" aria-pressed="true">Letters</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" data-mode="piano" aria-pressed="false">Computer keys as a piano</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" data-mode="midi" aria-pressed="false">MIDI keyboard</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-rest" title="z while typing letters">Rest</button>
            </div>
            <p class="nt-hint" id="nt-mode-help"></p>
          </div>
        </details>

      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-chords" open>
          <summary><h2>Chords</h2><span class="nt-sum" id="nt-chords-sum"></span></summary>
          <div class="nt-body">
            <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-chords-text">Chords by bar</label>
              <input type="text" id="nt-chords-text" class="nt-wide-in" placeholder="G | C D | Em | D7" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off"></div>
            <div class="nt-cbars" id="nt-chords-bars" aria-label="This chunk's chords, bar by bar"></div>
            <p class="nt-hint"><kbd>|</kbd> between bars. Two chords in a bar split it in half, three in thirds; <kbd>.</kbd> holds a place (<code>C . . G</code>: G on beat 4). On the score: click a chord symbol, or <kbd>"</kbd> on a note, to type one there; <kbd>h</kbd> / <kbd>l</kbd> or the arrows go to the note before / after, <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift+Tab</kbd> or <kbd>L</kbd> / <kbd>H</kbd> to the next / last chord or beat 1, <kbd>Enter</kbd> keeps it, <kbd>Esc</kbd> leaves it as it was.</p>
            <div class="nt-row">
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-chords-play" aria-pressed="false">Play chords in, one a bar</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-chords-clear">Clear this chunk's chords</button>
            </div>
            <p class="nt-big" id="nt-chords-heard" aria-live="polite"></p>
          </div>
        </details>

      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-rhythm" open>
          <summary><h2>Rhythm</h2><span class="nt-sum" id="nt-rhythm-sum"></span></summary>
          <div class="nt-body">
            <div class="nt-target nt-voice-pick" role="group" aria-label="Voice"></div>
            <div id="nt-rhythm-nometer">
              <p class="nt-hint">A rhythm needs a meter. Choose one first:</p>
              <div class="nt-row" id="nt-meter-quick"></div>
            </div>
            <div id="nt-rhythm-bank" hidden>
              <div class="nt-row" role="group" aria-label="How to enter rhythm">
                <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-rhythm-single" aria-pressed="false" title="Shift+R switches">One note at a time</button>
              </div>
              <div class="cell-bank" id="nt-cells"></div>
              <div class="nt-row">
                <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-rhythm-undo">Undo</button>
                <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-rhythm-clear">Clear this chunk's rhythm</button>
                <div class="cell-criteria" id="nt-cell-crit">
                  <label><input type="checkbox" data-crit="macrobeat" checked> Macrobeat</label>
                  <label><input type="checkbox" data-crit="microbeat" checked> Microbeat</label>
                  <label><input type="checkbox" data-crit="division"> Division</label>
                  <label><input type="checkbox" data-crit="elongation"> Elongation</label>
                  <label><input type="checkbox" data-crit="rest"> Rest</label>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p class="nt-hint" id="nt-rhythm-keys"></p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </details>

      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-words" open>
          <summary><h2>Words</h2><span class="nt-sum" id="nt-words-sum"></span></summary>
          <div class="nt-body">
            <textarea id="nt-words-text" class="nt-short" spellcheck="true" aria-label="Words of the selected chunk" placeholder="Twin-kle, twin-kle, lit-tle star"></textarea>
            <p class="nt-hint">One syllable for each note of the first voice. Put a hyphen between the syllables of a word, an underscore after a syllable held over the next note (<code>zoo-dle,_</code>), a <code>*</code> for a note with no word.</p>
            <div class="nt-row">
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-words-split">Split into syllables</button>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-words-paras" title="Each paragraph (lines with a blank line between) becomes a section of its own, Verse 1, Verse 2 ...">Paragraphs to sections</button>
              <span class="nt-hint" id="nt-words-count" style="margin:0"></span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </details>

      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-rec" open>
          <summary><h2>Recording</h2><span class="nt-sum" id="nt-rec-sum"></span></summary>
          <div class="nt-body">
            <div id="nt-rec-mount"></div>
            <div class="nt-row">
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-rec-sec">Go to section</label><select id="nt-rec-sec" disabled><option value="">(open a song file)</option></select></div>
              <label class="nt-through"><input type="checkbox" id="nt-rec-click" checked> Choosing a chunk moves the recording</label>
              <label class="nt-through"><input type="checkbox" id="nt-rec-follow"> The band follows the recording&rsquo;s tempo</label>
            </div>
            <p class="nt-hint">Open the song file from Timestamp Notes (or a bar map) and its recording. A chunk&rsquo;s first bar is taken to be the map&rsquo;s bar of the same number (a Pickup chunk is not a bar); the number box shifts that. With the band following, Play uses the map&rsquo;s tempo bar by bar instead of the piece&rsquo;s.</p>
            <p class="nt-hint" id="nt-rec-note" role="status"></p>
          </div>
        </details>

      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-loop" open>
          <summary><h2>Loop chunks</h2><span class="nt-sum" id="nt-loop-sum"></span></summary>
          <div class="nt-body">
            <div class="nt-row">
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-loop-mode" title="Listen: the recording. Play along: the recording and you, each pass a take. Play alone: the recording silent, a click, each pass a take. Listen, then play: the two by turns.">Loop</label><select id="nt-loop-mode"><option value="listen">Listen</option><option value="along">Play along</option><option value="alone">Play alone (click)</option><option value="cycle">Listen, then play</option></select></div>
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn" id="nt-loop-go">Loop this chunk</button>
            </div>
            <ol class="nt-loop-rows" id="nt-loop-rows"></ol>
            <p class="nt-hint" id="nt-loop-empty">Open the song file from Timestamp Notes in the Recording part: each chunk is found in the recording through its section, and loops from its <b>lead-in</b> to its <b>stop</b>.</p>
            <p class="nt-hint">Keys: <kbd>\</kbd> then <kbd>p</kbd> loop on/off, <kbd>,</kbd> <kbd>.</kbd> the chunk before / after, <kbd>-</kbd> <kbd>=</kbd> lead-in, <kbd>{</kbd> <kbd>}</kbd> stop, <kbd>m</kbd> loop mode, <kbd>Space</kbd> play/pause, <kbd>a</kbd> this chunk again. Every pass you play is a take of the chunk (Play it in's settings: split, left hand); run on past the stop and the next chunks get drafts. A split or joined chunk keeps its timing: it comes from the bars. ≈: the map has no such section (its bar number is used); ⚠: the section's bars here and in the map differ.</p>
            <p class="nt-hint" id="nt-loop-note" role="status"></p>
          </div>
        </details>

      <details class="nt-panel" id="nt-take" open>
          <summary><h2>Play it in time: more</h2><span class="nt-sum" id="nt-take-sum"></span></summary>
          <div class="nt-body">
            <div class="nt-target nt-voice-pick" role="group" aria-label="Voice"></div>
            <div class="nt-row">
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-t-what">What</label>
                <select id="nt-t-what"><option value="melody">Notes</option><option value="chords">Chords</option><option value="both">Both: chords below middle C</option></select></div>
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-t-bpm">Tempo</label><input type="number" id="nt-t-bpm" min="30" max="240" value="80"></div>
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-t-count">Count-in</label><select id="nt-t-count"><option value="1">1 bar</option><option value="2">2 bars</option></select></div>
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-t-len">Length</label>
                <select id="nt-t-len"><option value="0">Until I stop</option><option value="2">2 bars</option><option value="4">4 bars</option><option value="8">8 bars</option><option value="16">16 bars</option></select></div>
            </div>
            <div class="nt-row">
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-t-res">Shortest note</label><select id="nt-t-res"><option value="1">Eighth</option><option value="0.5">Sixteenth</option></select></div>
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-t-feel">Feel</label><select id="nt-t-feel"><option value="straight">Straight</option><option value="swing">Swing</option></select></div>
              <div class="nt-field"><label for="nt-t-trip">Triplets</label><select id="nt-t-trip"><option value="off">Off</option><option value="auto">When played</option></select></div>
            </div>
            <div class="nt-row">
              <button type="button" class="nt-btn is-main" id="nt-t-rec">&#9679; Record</button>
            </div>
            <p class="nt-big" id="nt-t-status" aria-live="polite"></p>
            <p class="nt-hint">Listens to a MIDI keyboard and to the computer keys (laid out as a piano). What you play replaces this chunk's notes (and rhythm), or its chords, in the voice chosen above.</p>
          </div>
        </details>
    </aside>
    <nav class="nt-nav" aria-label="Sections on this page">
      <p>On this page</p>
      <ul id="nt-nav"></ul>
      <p class="nt-nav-tip">Shift+click: fold the rest. Drag a part's &#10303; grip, or click &#8644;, to move it to the other column.</p>
      <button type="button" class="nt-btn nt-reset-cols" title="Every part back in the column it started in">Reset columns</button>
    </nav>
  </div>
</div>

<script src="/apps/shared/lyric-align.js?v=3"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/melody-dwim.js?v=2"></script>

<link rel="stylesheet" href="/apps/shared/timestamp-player/player.css?v=2">
<script src="/apps/shared/timestamp-player/player.js?v=8"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/timestamp-player/recording-follow.js?v=4"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/timestamp-player/phrases.js?v=8"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/chunk-loop.js?v=1"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var D = NotationDoc, CE = ChordEntry, $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var KEYS = ["C","G","D","A","E","B","F#","F","Bb","Eb","Ab","Db","Am","Em","Bm","F#m","C#m","Dm","Gm","Cm","Fm"];
  var METERS = ["2/4","3/4","4/4","6/8","9/8","12/8","5/8","7/8"];
  var CLEFS = [["treble", "Treble"], ["bass", "Bass"], ["alto", "Alto"], ["tenor", "Tenor"]];
  var MODES = [["", "Major"], ["m", "Minor (natural)"], ["hm", "Harmonic minor"], ["dor", "Dorian"], ["phr", "Phrygian"], ["lyd", "Lydian"], ["mix", "Mixolydian"], ["loc", "Locrian"]];
  var MODE_FIFTHS = { "": 0, m: -3, hm: -3, dor: -2, phr: -4, lyd: 1, mix: -1, loc: -5 };
  var TONICS = ["C", "Db", "D", "Eb", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "Ab", "A", "Bb", "B"];
  var ENH = { C: "B#", "B#": "C", Db: "C#", "C#": "Db", Eb: "D#", "D#": "Eb", E: "Fb", Fb: "E", F: "E#", "E#": "F", "F#": "Gb", Gb: "F#", Ab: "G#", "G#": "Ab", Bb: "A#", "A#": "Bb", B: "Cb", Cb: "B" };
  function splitKey(k) { var m = /^([A-G][#b]?)(.*)$/.exec(k || ""); return m ? { tonic: m[1], mode: m[2] } : null; }
  function keyFifths(tonic, mode) { return "FCGDAEB".indexOf(tonic[0]) - 1 + (tonic[1] === "#" ? 7 : tonic[1] === "b" ? -7 : 0) + (MODE_FIFTHS[mode] || 0); }
  var KEYNAME = function (k) {
    var p = splitKey(k); if (!p) return k;
    var mn = (MODES.find(function (x) { return x[0] === p.mode; }) || ["", p.mode])[1].replace(" (natural)", "").toLowerCase();
    return p.tonic.replace("b", "\u266d").replace("#", "\u266f") + " " + mn;
  };
  var DICT = /[?&]dictation=1/.test(location.search) && window.opener;   // opened by the Dictation page: a scratch doc, handed back
  var ENDING = /[?&]ending=1/.test(location.search) && window.parent !== window;   // in the Write an Ending lesson's frame
  // ?stage=1, framed by a Notation lesson: only the parts the lesson has reached are shown (see "stage" below)
  var STAGE = /[?&]stage=1/.test(location.search) && window.parent !== window;
  var STORE = DICT ? "ntDictDoc" : ENDING ? "ntEndingDoc" : STAGE ? "ntStageDoc" : "ntDoc", OPEN = ENDING ? "ntEndingOpen" : STAGE ? "ntStageOpen" : "ntOpen";
  if (ENDING || STAGE) {   // framed: no site chrome; the lesson around it has the navbar and its own jump bar
    if (ENDING) { $("nt-rhythm-clear").textContent = "Clear my ending"; $("nt-root").classList.add("nt-ending"); }
    else $("nt-root").classList.add("nt-stage");
    var fc = document.createElement("style");
    fc.textContent = "#quarto-header,footer.footer,#quarto-sidebar,#quarto-margin-sidebar,.nav-footer{display:none!important}" +
      "body{padding-top:0!important}main.content{margin-top:0!important}#nt-root .nt-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important}#nt-root .nt-nav{display:none!important}";
    document.head.appendChild(fc);
  }

  // a select's value, adding the option first when it isn't in the list (a custom meter, a key with a mode)
  function setSel(el, v) {
    if (el.dataset.kind === "meter" && ![].some.call(el.options, function (o) { return o.value === "other"; })) el.add(new Option("Other\u2026", "other"));
    if (v && ![].some.call(el.options, function (o) { return o.value === v; })) {
      var o = new Option(el.dataset.kind === "key" ? KEYNAME(v) : v, v), oth = [].find.call(el.options, function (x) { return x.value === "other"; });
      el.add(o, oth || null);
    }
    el.value = v || "";
    if (el._sync) el._sync();
  }
  // a key menu shown as tonic + tonality + an enharmonic switch (C# major <-> Db major); the select itself stays, hidden, as the value
  function keyPicker(sel) {
    sel.style.display = "none";
    var w = document.createElement("span"); w.className = "nt-keypick";
    var ts = document.createElement("select"), ms = document.createElement("select"), eb = document.createElement("button");
    ts.setAttribute("aria-label", "Tonic"); ms.setAttribute("aria-label", "Tonality");
    ms.innerHTML = MODES.map(function (m) { return '<option value="' + m[0] + '">' + m[1] + "</option>"; }).join("");
    eb.type = "button"; eb.className = "nt-btn nt-enh"; eb.textContent = "\u266f/\u266d"; eb.title = "Enharmonic: the same key spelled the other way (C\u266f \u2194 D\u266d, B \u2194 C\u266d)";
    w.appendChild(ts); w.appendChild(ms); w.appendChild(eb); sel.parentNode.insertBefore(w, sel.nextSibling);
    function tonics(cur) {
      var list = TONICS.slice(); if (cur && list.indexOf(cur) < 0) list.splice(list.indexOf(ENH[cur]) + 1 || list.length, 0, cur);
      ts.innerHTML = '<option value="">' + (sel.options[0] ? sel.options[0].text : "Choose") + "</option>" + list.map(function (t) { return '<option value="' + t + '">' + t.replace("b", "\u266d").replace("#", "\u266f") + "</option>"; }).join("");
    }
    function emit(t) { setSel(sel, t ? t + ms.value : ""); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event("change")); }
    ts.onchange = function () { emit(ts.value); ts.blur(); };
    ms.onchange = function () { if (ts.value) { var t = ts.value; if (Math.abs(keyFifths(t, ms.value)) > 7 && ENH[t]) t = ENH[t]; emit(t); } ms.blur(); };
    eb.onclick = function () { var t = ts.value, a = ENH[t]; if (a && Math.abs(keyFifths(a, ms.value)) <= 7) emit(a); eb.blur(); };
    sel._sync = function () {
      var p = splitKey(sel.value); tonics(p && p.tonic);
      ts.value = p ? p.tonic : ""; ms.value = p ? p.mode : ""; ms.disabled = !p;
      var a = p && ENH[p.tonic]; eb.disabled = !(a && Math.abs(keyFifths(a, p.mode)) <= 7);
    };
    sel._sync();
  }
  // a meter menu with Other...: two number boxes for any meter (5/4, 7/16 ...)
  function meterPicker(sel) {
    sel.dataset.kind = "meter";
    var w = document.createElement("span"); w.className = "nt-meterpick"; w.hidden = true;
    w.innerHTML = '<input type="number" min="1" max="32" aria-label="Beats in a bar"> / <input type="number" min="1" max="32" aria-label="Note value of a beat"> <button type="button" class="nt-btn nt-mini">Use</button>';
    sel.parentNode.insertBefore(w, sel.nextSibling);
    var n = w.children[0], d = w.children[1], orig = sel.onchange;
    function use() {
      var a = +n.value, b = +d.value;
      if (!(a >= 1 && a <= 32) || [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32].indexOf(b) < 0) { n.focus(); return; }
      w.hidden = true; setSel(sel, a + "/" + b); if (orig) orig.call(sel);
    }
    w.children[2].onclick = use;
    n.onkeydown = d.onkeydown = function (e) { if (e.key === "Enter") use(); e.stopPropagation(); };
    sel.onchange = function () {
      if (this.value === "other") { var m = /^(\d+)\/(\d+)$/.exec(doc.meter || ""); n.value = m ? m[1] : ""; d.value = m ? m[2] : "4"; w.hidden = false; n.focus(); return; }
      w.hidden = true; if (orig) orig.call(this);
    };
    setSel(sel, sel.value);
  }

  var doc = D.upgrade(load() || D.create());
  var cur = 0, voice = 0;         // where entry goes: chunk and voice
  var sel = null;                 // { chunk, voice, slot } or { chunk, voice, pitch } (a waiting note)
  var mode = "letters", chordsIn = false, rec = null;
  var history = [], map = [], pmap = [], tune = null, cells = [], guessRefused = null, editing = null, shownCur = -1;

  function load() { try { var s = localStorage.getItem(STORE); return s ? JSON.parse(s) : null; } catch (e) { return null; } }
  function save() {
    try { localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(doc)); } catch (e) {}
    if (ENDING) endTell({ type: "end-change", abc: D.toAbc(doc).abc });
    if (STAGE) endTell({ type: "st-change", doc: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(doc)), abc: D.toAbc(doc).abc });
  }
  function endTell(m) { try { window.parent.postMessage(m, location.origin); } catch (e) {} }
  function snap() { history.push(JSON.stringify(doc)); if (history.length > 200) history.shift(); }
  function change(f) { snap(); f(); save(); render(); }
  function status(s) { $("nt-status").textContent = s || ""; }
  function chunk() { return doc.chunks[cur]; }
  function part() { return D.part(chunk(), voice); }
  function here() { return D.at(doc, cur); }
  function msg(s) { $("nt-c-msg").hidden = !s; $("nt-c-msg").textContent = s || ""; }
  function cname(i) { return doc.chunks[i].name || "Chunk " + (i + 1); }

  // ---- sections: collapsible, with the jump bar --------------------------------------------------------------------
  // every part moves between the two columns (panel-columns.js), first, so the sidebar lists them where they are
  if (!ENDING && window.PanelColumns) PanelColumns.init({ columns: [document.querySelector("#nt-root .nt-main"), document.querySelector("#nt-root .nt-side")],
    panels: "details.nt-panel", key: "ntColumns", reset: document.querySelector("#nt-root .nt-reset-cols") });
  var panels = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#nt-root details.nt-panel"));
  document.addEventListener("panelcolumns:move", function () {
    panels.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.compareDocumentPosition(b) & 4 ? -1 : 1; })
      .forEach(function (p) { var a = document.querySelector('#nt-nav a[data-for="' + p.id + '"]'); if (a) $("nt-nav").appendChild(a.parentNode); });
  });
  var shut = {}; try { shut = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(OPEN) || "{}"); } catch (e) {}
  if (ENDING) panels = panels.filter(function (p) { return getComputedStyle(p).display !== "none"; });
  panels.forEach(function (p) {
    if (shut[p.id]) p.open = false;
    var li = document.createElement("li"), a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = "#" + p.id; a.textContent = p.querySelector("summary h2").textContent; a.dataset.for = p.id;
    a.title = "Shift+click: open this and fold every other section";
    a.onclick = function (e) { e.preventDefault(); if (e.shiftKey) panels.forEach(function (o) { if (o !== p) o.open = false; }); jump(p.id); };
    li.appendChild(a); $("nt-nav").appendChild(li);
    p.addEventListener("toggle", function () {
      shut[p.id] = !p.open; try { localStorage.setItem(OPEN, JSON.stringify(shut)); } catch (e) {}
      a.classList.toggle("is-shut", !p.open);
      if (p.open) render();
    });
    a.classList.toggle("is-shut", !p.open);
  });
  function jump(id) {
    var p = $(id); p.open = true;
    p.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    p.classList.add("is-lit"); setTimeout(function () { p.classList.remove("is-lit"); }, 1400);
  }
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
    var seen = {};
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
      es.forEach(function (e) { seen[e.target.id] = e.isIntersecting; });
      var first = panels.find(function (p) { return seen[p.id]; });
      document.querySelectorAll("#nt-nav a").forEach(function (a) { a.classList.toggle("is-here", !!first && a.dataset.for === first.id); });
    }, { rootMargin: "-80px 0px -40% 0px" });
    panels.forEach(function (p) { io.observe(p); });
  }

  // ---- sound -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  var sfUrl = null; if (window.getSoundfontUrl) getSoundfontUrl().then(function (u) { sfUrl = u; });
  function hear(midis) {
    if (!sfUrl || !ABCJS.synth.supportsAudio()) return;
    ABCJS.synth.playEvent([].concat(midis).map(function (m) { return { pitch: m, volume: 90, start: 0, duration: 0.5, instrument: 0 }; }), [], 1000, sfUrl).catch(function () {});
  }
  var synth = null;
  // Space: from the active note (else the chunk's start) to the end of the selected chunk
  // (Play through, ticked: on past the chunk's end to the end of the piece)
  function playChunk() {
    if (synth) { play(); return; }
    var ch = chunk(), len = D.chunkLen(doc, cur), a = activeSlot();
    if (!len) { status("Nothing in time in this chunk to play."); return; }
    var t = a && a.chunk === cur && !insertMode ? D.slotTime(D.part(ch, a.voice), a.slot) : insertMode ? D.slotTime(part(), Math.min(caretPos(), part().rhythm.length - 1)) : 0;
    if ($("nt-through").checked) { playThrough(t); return; }
    var sub = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(doc)), c = sub.chunks[cur], h0 = D.at(doc, cur);
    sub.chunks = [c]; sub.meter = h0.meter; sub.key = h0.key; sub.tempo = h0.tempo; sub.title = ""; c.meter = c.key = c.tempo = null; c.pickup = true;
    var drop = [];
    for (var v = 0; v < doc.voices.length; v++) {                 // each voice from time t on
      var p = D.part(c, v), at = 0, k = 0, keep = [], kp = [];
      drop[v] = 0;
      p.rhythm.forEach(function (r) {
        var end = at + r.durQ;
        if (end <= t + 1e-6) drop[v]++;
        if (end > t + 1e-6) keep.push(at >= t - 1e-6 ? r : { type: "rest", durQ: Math.round((end - t) * 1000) / 1000 });
        if (r.type === "note") { if (at >= t - 1e-6) kp.push(p.pitches[k]); k++; }
        at = end;
      });
      p.rhythm = keep; p.pitches = kp.filter(function (x) { return x !== undefined; });
    }
    c.chords = c.chords.filter(function (x) { return x.at >= t - 1e-6; }).map(function (x) { return { at: x.at - t, name: x.name }; }); c.chordLen = 0; c.words = "";
    carryChord(c, cur, t);
    var rs = D.toAbc(sub), vo = ABCJS.renderAbc(document.createElement("div"), rs.abc)[0];
    var pc = cur;
    play(vo, { doc: sub, toPage: function (ci, v, si) { return { chunk: pc, voice: v, slot: si + (drop[v] || 0) }; }, map: rs.map.map(function (m) { return Object.assign({}, m, { chunk: cur, slot: m.slot + (drop[m.voice] || 0) }); }) });
  }
  // c (a copy of chunk ci, cut to start at time t) gets the chord sounding at t, from earlier in the chunk or in the piece, so the
  // band plays a stretch that has no chord symbol of its own
  function carryChord(c, ci, t) {
    if (c.chords[0] && c.chords[0].at < 1e-6) return;
    for (var i = ci; i >= 0; i--) {
      var cs = doc.chunks[i].chords.filter(function (x) { return i < ci || x.at < t + 1e-6; });
      if (cs.length) { c.chords.unshift({ at: 0, name: cs[cs.length - 1].name }); return; }
    }
  }
  // From time t in the chunk on to the end of the piece. The chunk is cut at the barline before t (what comes before t in that
  // bar is rest), so the bars after it stay where they are.
  function playThrough(t) {
    var sub = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(doc)), h0 = D.at(doc, cur), c = sub.chunks[cur], mi = D.meterInfo(h0.meter) || { barQ: 4 };
    var lead = c.lead > 1e-6 && c.lead < mi.barQ - 1e-6 ? c.lead : 0;
    var tb = t < lead + 1e-6 ? 0 : lead + Math.floor((t - lead) / mi.barQ + 1e-6) * mi.barQ;
    sub.chunks = sub.chunks.slice(cur); sub.meter = h0.meter; sub.key = h0.key; sub.tempo = h0.tempo; sub.title = "";
    c.meter = c.key = c.tempo = null;
    if (tb > 0) { c.lead = 0; c.pickup = false; c.nl = []; }
    var drop = [];
    for (var v = 0; v < doc.voices.length; v++) {
      var p = D.part(c, v), at = 0, k = 0, keep = [], kp = [];
      drop[v] = 0;
      p.rhythm.forEach(function (r) {
        var end = at + r.durQ;
        if (end <= tb + 1e-6) drop[v]++;
        else if (at < t - 1e-6) keep.push(at >= tb - 1e-6 ? { type: "rest", durQ: r.durQ } : { type: "rest", durQ: Math.round((end - tb) * 1000) / 1000 });
        else { keep.push(r); if (r.type === "note") kp.push(p.pitches[k]); }
        if (r.type === "note") k++;
        at = end;
      });
      p.rhythm = keep; p.pitches = kp.filter(function (x) { return x !== undefined; });
    }
    c.chords = c.chords.filter(function (x) { return x.at >= tb - 1e-6; }).map(function (x) { return { at: x.at - tb, name: x.name }; });
    carryChord(c, cur, tb);
    c.chordLen = 0;
    var pc = cur, back = function (ci, v, si) { return { chunk: ci + pc, voice: v, slot: si + (ci === 0 ? drop[v] || 0 : 0) }; };
    var rs = D.toAbc(sub), vo = ABCJS.renderAbc(document.createElement("div"), rs.abc)[0];
    play(vo, { doc: sub, toPage: back, map: rs.map.map(function (m) { return Object.assign({}, m, back(m.chunk, m.voice, m.slot)); }) });
  }
  // Play: the notes on abcjs's piano; chords, when there are any, by the band (the Backing Track's players, in the piece's style),
  // started together. The note sounding is lit on the score (nt-playing).
  var tuneSrc = null, drawn = [], playing = null;
  function stopPlay() {
    var pl = playing; playing = null;
    if (synth) { try { synth.stop(); } catch (e) {} synth = null; }
    if (pl) { if (pl.band) pl.band.stop(); if (pl.cursor) pl.cursor.stop(); clearTimeout(pl.timer); clearInterval(pl.head); }
    lightHits(null);
    $("nt-play").innerHTML = "&#9654; Play";
  }
  function lightPlaying(src, ev) {
    if (!src || !ev || !ev.startCharArray) { lightHits(null); return; }
    lightHits(src.map.filter(function (m) { return ev.startCharArray.some(function (sc, i) { var ec = ev.endCharArray[i]; return m.start >= sc && m.start < Math.max(ec, sc + 1); }); }));
  }
  // light the drawn notes of these { chunk, voice, slot } (null: none)
  var litKey = "";
  function lightHits(hits) {
    var k = (hits || []).map(function (h) { return h.chunk + "/" + h.voice + "/" + h.slot; }).join(",");
    if (k === litKey && document.querySelector("#nt-paper .nt-playing")) return;
    litKey = k;

  // ---- drawing -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // abcjs starts a note after a barline at the space before it ("| G2": G's startChar is the space), so a drawn element
  // is matched to the map's entry whose start falls inside it, not by an equal start
  function covers(el, m) { return el.startChar <= m.start && m.start < Math.max(el.endChar, el.startChar + 1); }
  function lightSelection(t, m, want) {
    if (!t || !want) return;
    var hit = m.filter(want);
    t.lines.forEach(function (l) { (l.staff || []).forEach(function (st) { st.voices.forEach(function (v) { v.forEach(function (el) {
      if (el.abselem && hit.some(function (e) { return covers(el, e); })) el.abselem.elemset.forEach(function (g) { g.classList.add("nt-sel"); });
    }); }); }); });
  }
  function mark(on, label) { return on ? '<span class="nt-yes" aria-label="' + label + '">&#10003;</span>' : '<span class="nt-no" aria-label="no ' + label + '">&middot;</span>'; }
  function options(list, first, name) {
    return (first ? '<option value="">' + first + "</option>" : "") + list.map(function (k) { var v = Array.isArray(k) ? k[0] : k; return '<option value="' + v + '">' + (Array.isArray(k) ? k[1] : name ? name(k) : k) + "</option>"; }).join("");
  }

  function eyeButton(on, what) {
    return '<button type="button" class="nt-eye" aria-pressed="' + on + '" title="' + (on ? "Leave " + what + " out of the score" : "Show " + what + " in the score") + '" aria-label="Show ' + what + ' in the score">' +
      '<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M1 12s4-7 11-7 11 7 11 7-4 7-11 7S1 12 1 12z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>' + (on ? "" : '<line x1="3" y1="21" x2="21" y2="3"/>') + "</svg></button>";
  }
  function renderSheet() {
    var changes = D.hasChanges(doc);

      '<th class="nt-c">Chords</th><th class="nt-c">Rhythm</th><th class="nt-c">Pitches</th><th class="nt-c">Words</th><th>Style</th></tr>';
    var body = $("nt-sheet").tBodies[0]; body.innerHTML = "";

      if (ch.off) tr.className += " nt-off";

        "<td>" + (f.bars ? f.bars : "&ndash;") + "</td>" +
        (changes ? '<td class="nt-change">' + (showM && f.meter ? f.meter : "") + '</td><td class="nt-change">' + (showK && f.key ? f.key : "") + "</td>" : "") +
        '<td class="nt-c">' + mark(f.chords, "chords") + '</td><td class="nt-c">' + mark(f.rhythm, "rhythm") + '</td><td class="nt-c">' + mark(f.pitches, "pitches") + '</td><td class="nt-c">' + mark(f.words, "words") + "</td><td></td>";
      tr.lastChild.appendChild(styleButton(D.bandOf(doc, i), "chunk", function () { openBand({ chunk: i }, cname(i)); }));
      tr.querySelector(".nt-eye").onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); change(function () { ch.off = !ch.off; }); };
      var name = tr.querySelector("input");
      name.value = ch.name || "";
      name.oninput = function () { ch.name = name.value; save(); refreshText(); };
      name.onfocus = function () { if (cur !== i) { cur = i; sel = null; render(); var r = body.querySelector('tr[data-chunk="' + i + '"] input'); if (r) r.focus(); } };

    var allFolded = secs.length && secs.every(function (x) { return x.folded; }), allShown = secs.every(function (x) { return !x.hidden; }) && doc.chunks.every(function (c) { return !c.off; });
    $("nt-fold-all").textContent = allFolded ? "Unfold all" : "Fold all";
    $("nt-fold-all").onclick = function () { change(function () { secs.forEach(function (x) { doc.chunks[x.start].folded = !allFolded; }); var sc = D.sectionOf(doc, cur); if (!allFolded && sc) cur = sc.start; sel = null; }); };
    $("nt-eye-all").textContent = allShown ? "Hide all" : "Show all";
    $("nt-eye-all").title = allShown ? "Leave every chunk and section out of the score" : "Show every chunk and section in the score";
    $("nt-eye-all").onclick = function () { change(function () { secs.forEach(function (x) { doc.chunks[x.start].hidden = allShown; }); doc.chunks.forEach(function (c) { c.off = allShown; }); }); };
    var ch = chunk();
    $("nt-c-up").disabled = cur === 0; $("nt-c-down").disabled = cur === doc.chunks.length - 1;
    $("nt-c-merge").disabled = $("nt-c-join").disabled = cur === doc.chunks.length - 1;
    $("nt-c-sec").disabled = !!ch.heading;
    $("nt-c-at-lab").textContent = D.chunkLen(doc, cur) ? "Split after bar" : "Split after note";
    if (shownCur !== cur) {
      shownCur = cur;
      $("nt-c-meter").innerHTML = options(METERS, cur === 0 ? "Not chosen yet" : "Same as before");
      $("nt-c-key").innerHTML = options(KEYS, cur === 0 ? "Not chosen yet" : "Same as before", KEYNAME);
    }

    setSel($("nt-c-key"), cur === 0 ? (doc.key || "") : (ch.key || ""));
    if (document.activeElement !== $("nt-c-tempo")) { $("nt-c-tempo").value = cur === 0 ? (doc.tempo || "") : (ch.tempo || ""); $("nt-c-tempo").placeholder = cur === 0 ? "90" : String(D.at(doc, cur - 1).tempo || 90); }
    var total = doc.chunks.reduce(function (s, c, i) { return s + D.info(doc, i).bars; }, 0);

  }

  // ---- the band: the Backing Track in a window of its own, set to the Band tab for one portion ---------------------
  var btStyles = {}; try { btStyles = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("ntBtStyles") || "{}"); } catch (e) {}
  function styleLabel(st) { return st && st.style ? (btStyles[st.style] || st.style) : ""; }
  // the Style button of a row: its own settings in bold, settings it gets from its section or the piece in grey
  function styleButton(b, level, go) {
    var btn = document.createElement("button"); btn.type = "button"; btn.className = "nt-btn nt-style";
    var own = b.level === level, lab = styleLabel(b.state);
    var ico = '<svg class="nt-band-ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true">' +
      '<circle cx="6" cy="7" r="2.3"/><circle cx="12" cy="5.5" r="2.3"/><circle cx="18" cy="7" r="2.3"/>' +
      '<path d="M2.5 18c0-3 1.6-5 3.5-5s3.5 2 3.5 5M8.5 16.5c0-3 1.6-5 3.5-5s3.5 2 3.5 5M14.5 18c0-3 1.6-5 3.5-5s3.5 2 3.5 5"/></svg>';
    var text = own ? lab : lab ? "\u21b3 " + lab : "";
    btn.innerHTML = ico + (text ? "<span></span>" : "");
    if (text) btn.lastChild.textContent = text;
    btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Band style" + (text ? ": " + text : ""));
    if (!own) btn.classList.add(lab ? "is-inherited" : "is-none");
    btn.title = own ? "This " + level + "'s own band settings (" + lab + "). Click to change them in the Backing Track." :
      lab ? "Played with the " + b.level + "'s settings (" + lab + "). Click to give this " + level + " its own." : "Open the Backing Track's Band tab for this " + level + ".";
    btn.onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); go(); };

  }
  var bt = { win: null, ready: false, parts: null, sig: "", pending: null };
  function docSig() { return doc.chunks.length + ":" + doc.chunks.map(function (c) { return (c.heading || "") + "/" + c.name; }).join("|"); }
  function openBand(focus, label) {
    var ch = D.bandChart(doc, focus);
    if (!ch.parts.length) { $("nt-band-note").textContent = "There are no bars yet: give the piece a meter and some chords or rhythm first."; jump("nt-setup"); return; }
    var key = focus && focus.chunk != null ? "c:" + focus.chunk : focus && focus.section != null ? "s:" + focus.section : null;
    var idx = key ? ch.parts.findIndex(function (p) { return p.key === key; }) : -1;
    var msgs = [{ type: "bt-load", abc: ch.abc, title: doc.title || "Untitled", setup: doc.band || ch.setup.sections.length ? ch.setup : null, report: true, host: "the Notation page" },
                { type: "bt-focus", section: idx, label: label ? "\u201C" + label + "\u201D" : "the whole piece" }];
    bt.parts = ch.parts; bt.sig = docSig();
    if (!bt.win || bt.win.closed) {
      bt.ready = false; bt.pending = msgs;
      bt.win = window.open("/tools/backing-track.html?remote=1", "nt-band");
      if (!bt.win) { $("nt-band-note").textContent = "The browser blocked the Backing Track window. Allow pop-ups for this site."; return; }
    } else if (bt.ready) { msgs.forEach(function (m) { bt.win.postMessage(m, location.origin); }); try { bt.win.focus(); } catch (e) {} }
    else bt.pending = msgs;

  }
  window.addEventListener("message", function (e) {

  // a section's heading row: fold, name, move, duplicate, take the heading away
  function sectionRow(sec, cols) {

    tr.setAttribute("aria-selected", cur >= sec.start && cur < sec.end ? "true" : "false");
    var bars = 0; for (var i = sec.start; i < sec.end; i++) bars += D.info(doc, i).bars;

      '<button type="button" class="nt-fold" aria-expanded="' + !sec.folded + '" aria-label="' + (sec.folded ? "Unfold " : "Fold ") + sec.name + '">' + (sec.folded ? "&#9656;" : "&#9662;") + "</button>" +
      '<button type="button" class="nt-eye" aria-pressed="' + !sec.hidden + '" title="' + (sec.hidden ? "Show this section in the score" : "Leave this section out of the score") + '" aria-label="Show ' + sec.name.replace(/[<&"]/g, "") + ' in the score">' +
      '<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M1 12s4-7 11-7 11 7 11 7-4 7-11 7S1 12 1 12z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>' + (sec.hidden ? '<line x1="3" y1="21" x2="21" y2="3"/>' : "") + "</svg></button>" +
      '<input type="text" list="nt-sec-names" aria-label="Name of section">' +
      '<button type="button" class="nt-btn nt-mini" data-s="up" title="Move the section up">&#8593;</button>' +
      '<button type="button" class="nt-btn nt-mini" data-s="down" title="Move the section down">&#8595;</button>' +
      '<button type="button" class="nt-btn nt-mini" data-s="dup" title="Duplicate the section" aria-label="Duplicate the section">&#10697;</button>' +
      '<button type="button" class="nt-btn nt-mini" data-s="unhead" title="Remove the heading (the chunks stay)" aria-label="Remove the heading">&#10005;</button>' +
      '<span class="nt-style-slot"></span><span class="nt-sec-sum">' + n + (n === 1 ? " chunk" : " chunks") + (bars ? ", " + Math.round(bars * 100) / 100 + " bars" : "") + "</span></div></td>";
    var inp = tr.querySelector("input"); inp.value = sec.name;

          else if (what === "dup") { cur = D.duplicateSection(doc, sec.start); }

    tr.querySelector('[data-s="up"]').disabled = k === 0; tr.querySelector('[data-s="down"]').disabled = k === secs.length - 1;
    return tr;
  }

  // the piece's tonality beside the Key menu, and handed to the site's shared key once the key is confirmed (the navbar's circle follows)
  function keyAnnounce() {
    var T = window.Tonality, out = $("nt-tonality"); if (!T || !out) return;
    if (!doc.keyConfirmed || !doc.key) { out.textContent = "\u2013"; return; }
    var t = T.keyToTonality(doc.key); if (!t) return;
    var chords = []; doc.chunks.forEach(function (c) { c.chords.forEach(function (x) { chords.push(x.name); }); });
    var flavor = T.flavorOf(chords, t.resting, t.mode);
    out.textContent = T.label({ resting: t.resting, mode: t.mode, flavor: flavor, tonic: t.tonic });
    T.setFromKey(doc.key, "notation", flavor);
  }

  function renderVoices() {
    var box = $("nt-voices"); box.innerHTML = "";

      var row = document.createElement("div"); row.className = "nt-voice";
      row.innerHTML = '<input type="text" aria-label="Name of voice ' + (v + 1) + '"><select aria-label="Clef of voice ' + (v + 1) + '">' + options(CLEFS) + "</select>" +
        (doc.voices.length > 1 ? '<button type="button" class="nt-btn">Remove</button>' : "");

    document.querySelectorAll(".nt-voice-pick").forEach(function (g) {

  function refreshText() {
    var r = D.toAbc(doc);

    return r;
  }

  function render() {

    $("nt-keyguess").hidden = !showGuess;

    $("nt-key-hint").textContent = doc.keyConfirmed ? "" : "No key yet: notes are written in C until you choose or confirm one.";
    $("nt-setup-sum").textContent = [doc.title, doc.meter, doc.keyConfirmed && doc.key ? KEYNAME(doc.key) : "", doc.voices.length > 1 ? doc.voices.length + " voices" : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");

    $("nt-chords-text").disabled = !mi;

    $("nt-words-count").textContent = nsyl ? nsyl + " syllables for " + nnotes + " notes" + (nsyl > nnotes && nnotes ? ": " + (nsyl - nnotes) + " left over" : "") : "";
    $("nt-words-sum").textContent = "into " + cname(cur);
```
